summary: Oscar Piastri won the Hungarian Grand Prix from P2 on the grid, 2.1s ahead of Lando Norris, with Lewis Hamilton completing the podium.
Sergio Perez made the biggest climb, from P16 to P7.
Valtteri Bottas had a day to forget, dropping from P12 to P16.
There were 40 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 2 times.
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 76 points over Lando Norris.
